notes: French tarragon is sterile and must be propagated by division or cuttings, not seed. Hardy to zone 4.
harvestIndicators: Cut soft tip growth before flower stalks form

seasonalTasks.title: Cut back tarragon in spring
seasonalTasks.body: Leave the tops standing over winter, then cut the plants back in spring just as growth starts.

seasonalTasks.title: Divide tarragon every few years
seasonalTasks.body: Divide the plants every 3 to 4 years to keep the planting vigorous and productive.
